text: Anybody can make history. Only a great man can write it.
author: Oscar Wilde

archive.text: The world is divided into men who have wit and no religion and men who have religion and no wit.
archive.author: Ibn Sina

archive.text: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
archive.author: Henry David Thoreau

archive.text: Divide each difficulty into as many parts as is feasible and necessary to resolve it.
archive.author: Rene Descartes

archive.text: I prefer a short life with width to a narrow one with length.
archive.author: Ibn Sina

archive.text: Man only likes to count his troubles; he doesn't calculate his happiness.
archive.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

archive.text: A dream is your creative vision for your life in the future. You must break out of your current comfort zone and become comfortable with the unfamiliar and the unknown.
archive.author: Denis Waitley

archive.text: I follow the Way of Love, and where love's caravan turns along the road, that is my religion and my faith.
archive.author: Ibn Arabi
